name: Freedom for All Creatures
summary: At the Grimtotem camp, Kindal Moonweaver asks you to free the captured faerie dragons. Neither Kindal nor Jer'kai knows what the Grimtotem clan intends. Kindal will go with you, while Jer'kai stays behind.

sections.title: Dragons in the Pen
sections.body: Kindal Moonweaver calls the Grimtotem clan filthy for taking faerie dragons. Neither Kindal nor Jer'kai knows what the clan intends, only that it means no good. They are not strong enough to fight into the camp, so Kindal asks you to help free the sprite darters. The Bamboo Cage Key opens their pen, and Kindal wants them to escape alive. Bring strong friends to stand with you.

sections.title: Kindal's Lookout
sections.body: Kindal waits on a ledge behind the Grimtotem Compound, above the water. A path climbs the cliff face to reach him. Kindal fights beside you through the camp. Jer'kai stays behind.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: Once the darters are free, Kindal gives thanks to Elune. The freed dragons may not remain free, so Kindal and Jer'kai intend to take the fight to the Grimtotem. Kindal sends you to speak with Jer'kai.

faq.q: Who is capturing the faerie dragons?
faq.answer: Kindal Moonweaver says the Grimtotem clan is capturing the faerie dragons. Kindal and Jer'kai do not know what the clan wants with them.

aliases: how to get to kindal moonweaver
faq.answer: Kindal Moonweaver waits on a ledge behind the Grimtotem Compound, above the water. Go left of the compound to find a path behind a tree that climbs the cliff face.

faq.q: What do I need to free the sprite darters?
faq.answer: The Bamboo Cage Key, which Kindal gives you, opens the pen in the Grimtotem camp. Kindal asks you to bring strong friends.
